items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: So Smiley wanted us to get out of town. And he said, oh, you boys ain't right. Yeah, yeah, yeah, that Charlie Mack must have been drunk. I said, I don't know, but we're going to stay, man. We got a contract for six weeks.

ctx.x: The City Hall, the big City Hall, right there. Oh, the City Hall, another club. The City Hall, yeah, sure, that's right, right on.

So Smiley wanted us to get out of town. And he said, oh, you boys ain't right. Yeah, yeah, yeah, that Charlie Mack must have been drunk. I said, I don't know, but we're going to stay, man. We got a contract for six weeks. We're going to stay. Oh, you're going to stay, huh? You're going to have a big cigar in his mind. All right. So we, I go up, I'm walking down Clark Street one day and who I run up at Charlie Mack. He said, what y'all doing? I said, man, what do we know? I said, we downstairs in the Lambs. We're…
